entries.name: Tourist visa (consular)
entries.notes: Sticker/label visa issued by an embassy, consulate, or authorized visa center.

entries.name: Tourist eVisa
entries.notes: Electronic visa applied for and issued online through an official portal.

entries.name: Electronic travel authorization
entries.notes: Pre-travel electronic authorization for otherwise visa-free or visa-waiver travellers (e.g. ESTA, UK ETA, NZeTA, Canadian eTA, K-ETA).

entries.name: Tourist visa on arrival
entries.notes: Visa granted at the border/airport on arrival; may require pre-registration.

entries.name: Visa-free entry (tourism)
entries.notes: No visa or authorization required for a tourist stay within the permitted period; a disposition, present so route records can bind conditions/evidence.

entries.name: Transit visa / authorization
entries.notes: Authorization required to transit; included because tourist itineraries traverse transit states.
